readout_other: ventricular effective refractory period; blood pressure response to LSG stimulation; ventricular arrhythmia incidence on ECG; H&E, TUNEL, c-fos western blot, IL-1b and IL-18 mRNA; thermocouple temperature
direction_notes: LIFU at 1.5 and 2.0 W attenuated left stellate ganglion function (smaller pressor response to LSG stimulation), prolonged ventricular ERP and reduced post-MI ventricular arrhythmias and LSG c-fos; 1.0 W and sham had no effect on LSG function.
safety_notes: No damage on H&E or increase in TUNEL staining in the LSG; temperature rose by at most 0.7 C (statistically significant at 1.5 and 2.0 W).
